films.title: Hugo
films.summary: Orphaned and alone except for an uncle, Hugo Cabret lives in the walls of a train station in 1930s Paris. Hugo's job is to oil and maintain the station's clocks, but to him, his more important task is to protect a broken automaton and notebook left to him by his late father. Accompanied by the goddaughter of an embittered toy merchant, Hugo embarks on a quest to solve the mystery of the automaton and find a place he can call home.

films.title: Rushmore
films.summary: When a beautiful first-grade teacher arrives at a prep school, she soon attracts the attention of an ambitious teenager named Max, who quickly falls in love with her. Max turns to the father of two of his schoolmates for advice on how to woo the teacher. However, the situation soon gets complicated when Max's new friend becomes involved with her, setting the two pals against one another in a war for her attention.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">RUSHMORE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">WES ANDERSON // 1998</text></svg>

films.title: Midnight in Paris
films.summary: While on a trip to Paris with his fiancée's family, a nostalgic screenwriter finds himself mysteriously going back to the 1920s every day at midnight.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">MIDNIGHT IN PARIS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">WOODY ALLEN // 2011</text></svg>

films.title: Bram Stoker's Dracula
films.summary: Count Dracula, a 15th-century prince, is condemned to live off the blood of the living for eternity. Young lawyer Jonathan Harker is sent to Dracula's castle to finalise a land deal, but when the Count sees a photo of Harker's fiancée, Mina, the spitting image of his dead wife, he imprisons him and sets off for London to track her down.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">BRAM STOKER'S DRACULA</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">FRANCIS FORD COPPOLA // 1992</text></svg>

films.title: Possible Love
films.summary: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">POSSIBLE LOVE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">LEE CHANG-DONG // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Digger
films.summary: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">DIGGER</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">ALEJANDRO G. IÑÁRRIT // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Minority Report
films.summary: John Anderton is a top 'Precrime' cop in the late-21st century, when technology can predict crimes before they're committed. But Anderton becomes the quarry when another investigator targets him for a murder charge.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">MINORITY REPORT</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">STEVEN SPIELBERG // 2002</text></svg>

films.title: Hellraiser
films.summary: A hedonistic man finds a mysterious puzzle box that summons a group of gruesome beings known as the Cenobites. These otherworldly entities open the doors to a dominion where pain and pleasure are indivisible.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">HELLRAISER</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">CLIVE BARKER // 1987</text></svg>

films.title: Cat People
films.summary: After years of separation, Irena Gallier and her minister brother, Paul, reunite in New Orleans. When zoologists capture a wild panther, Irena is drawn to the cat – and zoo curator Oliver to her. Soon, Paul will have to reveal the family secret: that when sexually aroused, they revert into predatory jungle cats.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">CAT PEOPLE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">PAUL SCHRADER // 1982</text></svg>

films.title: The River Wild
films.summary: Gail and Tom Hartman are struggling to stay together and decide to take a white-water rafting holiday adventure in Montana for their son Roarke's 10th birthday, only to meet up with a pair of mysterious men whose desperation grows, turning their vacation into a nightmare.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE RIVER WILD</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">CURTIS HANSON // 1994</text></svg>

films.title: The Devils
films.summary: In 1634 France, charismatic Father Urbain Grandier becomes the target of sexually depraved Sister Jeanne's accusations of witchcraft, which corrupt officials of church and state are all too happy to exploit.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE DEVILS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">KEN RUSSELL // 1971</text></svg>

films.title: Clayface
films.summary: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">CLAYFACE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">JAMES WATKINS // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Dracula
films.summary: In late 15th-century Eastern Europe, Prince Vlad II’s bride is brutally murdered. As a result, he renounces God and damns Heaven itself. Cursed with eternal life, Vlad is reborn as Dracula, an immortal warlord who defies fate in a blood-soaked crusade to wrench his lost love back from death.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">DRACULA</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">LUC BESSON // 2025</text></svg>

films.title: The Social Reckoning
films.summary: Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE SOCIAL RECKONING</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">AARON SORKIN // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: The Addams Family
films.summary: When a man claiming to be long-lost Uncle Fester reappears after 25 years lost, the family plans a celebration to wake the dead. But the kids barely have time to warm up the electric chair before Morticia begins to suspect Fester is fraud when he can't recall any of the details of Fester's life.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE ADDAMS FAMILY</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">BARRY SONNENFELD // 1991</text></svg>

films.title: You Can See Everything
films.summary: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">YOU CAN SEE EVERYTHING</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">NATHAN FIELDER // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: On the Road
films.summary: Sal Paradise is a young writer whose life is shaken and ultimately redefined by the arrival of Dean Moriarty, a free-spirited, fearless, fast talking Westerner and his girl, Marylou. Traveling cross-country, Sal and Dean venture out on a personal quest for freedom from the conformity and conservatism engulfing them in search of the unknown, themselves, and the pursuit of “it” -- the pure essence of experience.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ON THE ROAD</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">WALTER SALLES // 2012</text></svg>

films.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
films.summary: After a family tragedy, three generations of the Deetz family return home to Winter River. Still haunted by Betelgeuse, Lydia's life is turned upside down when her teenage daughter, Astrid, accidentally opens the portal to the Afterlife.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">BEETLEJUICE BEETLEJUICE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">TIM BURTON // 2024</text></svg>

films.title: Begotten
films.summary: Begotten is the creation myth brought to life, the story of no less than the violent death of God and the (re)birth of nature on a barren earth.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">BEGOTTEN</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">E. ELIAS MERHIGE // 1991</text></svg>

films.title: Far from Heaven
films.summary: In 1950s Connecticut, a housewife's life is upended by a marital crisis and mounting racial tensions in society.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">FAR FROM HEAVEN</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">TODD HAYNES // 2002</text></svg>

films.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
films.summary: When a nobleman is threatened by a family curse on his newly inherited estate, detective Sherlock Holmes is hired to investigate.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE HOUND OF THE BASKERVILLES</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">TERENCE FISHER // 1959</text></svg>

films.title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
films.summary: Harry Lehman is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. Wallets stuffed with cash have been replaced by easily cancelled credit cards, and Harry struggles to make ends meet as he cares for his disabled wife, Rosie. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE ONLY LIVING PICKPOCKET IN NEW YORK</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">NOAH SEGAN // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: NAZA
films.summary: Filmed at night from Tel Aviv rooftops, this investigative documentary examines the civilian casualties of Israel's military operations in Gaza and the systems behind targeted killings of Palestinians.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">NAZA</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">YUVAL ABRAHAM // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: The Curse of Frankenstein
films.summary: Baron Victor Frankenstein has discovered life's secret and unleashed a blood-curdling chain of events resulting from his creation: a cursed creature with a horrid face — and a tendency to kill.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE CURSE OF FRANKENSTEIN</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">TERENCE FISHER // 1957</text></svg>

films.title: Edward Scissorhands
films.summary: A small suburban town receives a visit from a castaway unfinished science experiment named Edward.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">EDWARD SCISSORHANDS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">TIM BURTON // 1990</text></svg>

films.title: Freaked
films.summary: A vain actor, his best friend, and an activist end up at a mutant freak farm run by a weirdo scientist.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">FREAKED</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">ALEX WINTER // 1993</text></svg>

films.title: Fjord
films.summary: After moving from Romania to a remote Norwegian village to rebuild their lives, a family finds hope in their welcoming neighbors, but their fragile new beginning is threatened when their young daughter arrives at school covered in bruises.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">FJORD</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">CRISTIAN MUNGIU // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: The Exorcist
films.summary: When a mysterious entity possesses a young girl, her mother seeks the help of two Catholic priests to save her life.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE EXORCIST</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">WILLIAM FRIEDKIN // 1973</text></svg>

films.title: Halloween
films.summary: Fifteen years after murdering his sister on Halloween Night 1963, Michael Myers escapes from a mental hospital and returns to the small town of Haddonfield, Illinois to kill again.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">HALLOWEEN</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">JOHN CARPENTER // 1978</text></svg>

films.title: Fatherland
films.summary: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">FATHERLAND</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">PAWEŁ PAWLIKOWSKI // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Coco
films.summary: Despite his family’s baffling generations-old ban on music, Miguel dreams of becoming an accomplished musician like his idol, Ernesto de la Cruz. Desperate to prove his talent, Miguel finds himself in the stunning and colorful Land of the Dead following a mysterious chain of events. Along the way, he meets charming trickster Hector, and together, they set off on an extraordinary journey to unlock the real story behind Miguel's family history.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">COCO</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">LEE UNKRICH // 2017</text></svg>

films.title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre
films.summary: Five friends head out to rural Texas to visit the grave of a grandfather. On the way, they stumble across what appears to be a deserted house, only to discover something sinister within. Something armed with a chainsaw.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE TEXAS CHAIN SAW MASSACRE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">TOBE HOOPER // 1974</text></svg>

films.title: Street Fighter
films.summary: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">STREET FIGHTER</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">KITAO SAKURAI // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Sense and Sensibility
films.summary: A charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">SENSE AND SENSIBILITY</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">GEORGIA OAKLEY // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Casino Royale
films.summary: Le Chiffre, a banker to the world's terrorists, is scheduled to participate in a high-stakes poker game in Montenegro, where he intends to use his winnings to establish his financial grip on the terrorist market. M sends Bond—on his maiden mission as a 00 Agent—to attend this game and prevent Le Chiffre from winning. With the help of Vesper Lynd and Felix Leiter, Bond enters the most important poker game in his already dangerous career.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">CASINO ROYALE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">MARTIN CAMPBELL // 2006</text></svg>

films.title: Wildwood
films.summary: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue's abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">WILDWOOD</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">TRAVIS KNIGHT // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Autumn Sonata
films.summary: After a seven-year absence, Charlotte Andergast travels to Sweden to reunite with her daughter Eva. The pair have a troubled relationship: Charlotte sacrificed the responsibilities of motherhood for a career as a classical pianist. Over an emotional night, the pair reopen the wounds of the past. Charlotte gets another shock when she finds out that her mentally impaired daughter, Helena, is out of the asylum and living with Eva.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">AUTUMN SONATA</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">INGMAR BERGMAN // 1978</text></svg>

films.title: The Gorgon
films.summary: In the early 20th century a village experienced a series of inexplicable murders. All the victims were young men who had been turned to stone. The perpetrator of these deaths was a being so repulsive that she transformed the onlooker using the power of her deadly stare. Much of the time the creature took the form of a beautiful and seductive woman, but during periods of the full moon she becomes a living horror, vicious and deadly. A professor has come to investigate the deaths, bringing with him his beautiful assistant whose knowledge of the Gorgon is more intimate than anyone would ever realise.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE GORGON</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">TERENCE FISHER // 1964</text></svg>

films.title: A Place in the Sun
films.summary: A young social climber wins the heart of a beautiful heiress but his former girlfriend's pregnancy stands in the way of his ambition.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">A PLACE IN THE SUN</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">GEORGE STEVENS // 1951</text></svg>

films.title: Twilight
films.summary: When Bella Swan moves to a small town in the Pacific Northwest, she falls in love with Edward Cullen, a mysterious classmate who reveals himself to be a 108-year-old vampire. Despite Edward's repeated cautions, Bella can't stay away from him, a fatal move that endangers her own life.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">TWILIGHT</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">CATHERINE HARDWICKE // 2008</text></svg>

films.title: The History of Concrete
films.summary: After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, filmmaker John Wilson tries to use the same formula to sell a documentary about concrete.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE HISTORY OF CONCRETE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">JOHN WILSON // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Grey Gardens
films.summary: Based on the life stories of the eccentric aunt and first cousin of Jackie Onassis raised as Park Avenue débutantes but who withdrew from New York society, taking shelter at their Long Island summer home, "Grey Gardens." As their wealth and contact with the outside world dwindled, so did their grasp on reality.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">GREY GARDENS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">MICHAEL SUCSY // 2009</text></svg>

films.title: Cria!
films.summary: Ana, an eight-year-old girl living in Madrid with her grandmother and two sisters, mourns the death of her mother.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">CRIA!</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">CARLOS SAURA // 1976</text></svg>

films.title: LA BOLA NEGRA
films.summary: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">LA BOLA NEGRA</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">JAVIER AMBROSSI // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Hocus Pocus
films.summary: After 300 years of slumber, three sister witches are accidentally resurrected in Salem on Halloween night, and it is up to three kids and their newfound feline friend to put an end to the witches' reign of terror once and for all.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">HOCUS POCUS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">KENNY ORTEGA // 1993</text></svg>

films.title: Klara and the Sun
films.summary: When Klara, an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home, meets Josie, each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother and they've suffered great loss, but Klara's innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie's complicated world.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">KLARA AND THE SUN</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">TAIKA WAITITI // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: The Brides of Dracula
films.summary: A young teacher on her way to a position in Transylvania helps a young man escape the shackles his mother has put on him. In so doing she innocently unleashes the horrors of the undead once again on the populace, including those at her school for ladies. Luckily for some, Dr. Van Helsing is already on his way.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE BRIDES OF DRACULA</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">TERENCE FISHER // 1960</text></svg>

films.title: Citizen Ruth
films.summary: "Citizen Ruth" is the story of Ruth Stoops, a woman who nobody even noticed -- until she got pregnant. Now, everyone wants a piece of her. The film is a comedy about one woman caught in the ultimate tug-of-war: a clash of wild, noisy, ridiculous people that rapidly dissolves into a media circus.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">CITIZEN RUTH</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ALEXANDER PAYNE // 1996</text></svg>

films.title: The Trouble with Harry
films.summary: In a quiet Vermont village, a corpse creates unexpected chaos as several townspeople each believe they may be to blame.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE TROUBLE WITH HARRY</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ALFRED HITCHCOCK // 1955</text></svg>

films.title: The Mosquito Bowl
films.summary: In the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, four college football stars enlist in the US Marines, discovering the strength of brotherhood and the cost of war.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE MOSQUITO BOWL</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">PETER BERG // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: When a Witness Recants
films.summary: In 1983, author Ta-Nehisi Coates learned that a 14-year-old boy was murdered in his Baltimore middle school. Upon revisiting the case, he uncovers the truth: Three innocent teenagers were wrongfully convicted and spent 36 years in prison — creating a lasting impact on the accused, the witnesses, and their community.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">WHEN A WITNESS RECANTS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">DAWN PORTER // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Gentle Monster
films.summary: After relocating with her family to the countryside, a renowned pianist uncovers a life-shattering truth that forces her to confront the complexities of love, trust, and deception.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">GENTLE MONSTER</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">MARIE KREUTZER // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Ju-on: The Grudge
films.summary: When a social worker is sent to check on a traumatized elderly woman whose family have moved in at the site of a notorious murder case, she unwittingly unleashes a cycle of terror that transmits via its victims.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">JU-ON: THE GRUDGE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">TAKASHI SHIMIZU // 2002</text></svg>

films.title: I Sell the Dead
films.summary: 18th century justice catches up with a pair of grave robbers. With only a few hours to go before his date with the guillotine, Arthur Blake tells his life story to Father Francis Duffy. Before long, Arthur spills the beans on how he got started in the grim corpse peddling business with seasoned ghoul Willie Grimes.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">I SELL THE DEAD</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">GLENN MCQUAID // 2008</text></svg>

films.title: Sans Soleil
films.summary: A woman narrates the thoughts of a world traveler, meditations on time and memory expressed in words and images from places as far-flung as Japan, Guinea-Bissau, Iceland, and San Francisco.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">SANS SOLEIL</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">CHRIS MARKER // 1983</text></svg>

films.title: Peppermint Frappé
films.summary: Julián, a middle-aged single doctor, is reunited with Pablo, a childhood friend who has just married Elena, a beautiful young woman.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">PEPPERMINT FRAPPÉ</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">CARLOS SAURA // 1967</text></svg>

films.title: All That Heaven Allows
films.summary: Two different social classes collide when Cary Scott, a wealthy upper-class widow, falls in love with her much younger and down-to-earth gardener, prompting disapproval and criticism from her children and country club friends.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ALL THAT HEAVEN ALLOWS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">DOUGLAS SIRK // 1955</text></svg>

films.title: Wicker
films.summary: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">WICKER</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">ELEANOR WILSON // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Wild Horse Nine
films.summary: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">WILD HORSE NINE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">MARTIN MCDONAGH // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Everest: The Other Side
films.summary: An intimate portrait of two people bound by love, ambition, and the pursuit of the impossible. Elite ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson fell deeply in love while reaching the pinnacle of their sport. Their drive sharpened into a shared dream: to climb and ski the direct North Face of Mount Everest—the most difficult and dangerous climb on the mountain and the most coveted ski line on Earth—something only a handful have ever achieved, and no one has successfully skied down.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">EVEREST: THE OTHER SIDE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">JIMMY CHIN // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: The Innkeepers
films.summary: During the final days at the Yankee Pedlar Inn, two employees determined to reveal the hotel's haunted past begin to experience disturbing events as old guests check in for a stay.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE INNKEEPERS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">TI WEST // 2012</text></svg>

films.title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
films.summary: A decade after his death, genre-defying filmmaker William Greaves has one last trick up his sleeve with what he considered the most important event he captured on film: a 1972 party he engineered with the living luminaries of the Harlem Renaissance.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ONCE UPON A TIME IN HARLEM</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">WILLIAM GREAVES // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: My Undesirable Friends: Part II - Exile
films.summary: A group of Russian independent journalists flee the country and navigate life in exile after the invasion of Ukraine, focusing on their dispersed lives and ongoing struggle for truth across different nations. While Part I documented their lives in Moscow facing mounting pressure from the Putin regime, Part II chronicles their forced displacement and new realities in various countries, continuing their mission against authoritarianism.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">MY UNDESIRABLE FRIENDS: PART II - EXILE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">JULIA LOKTEV // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: News From Home/News From House
films.summary: Documentary about a house and its politically divided ownership over time.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">NEWS FROM HOME/NEWS FROM HOUSE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">AMOS GITAI // 2006</text></svg>

films.title: An Autumn Afternoon
films.summary: Widower Shuhei Hirayama's caretaker is his 24-year-old daughter, Michiko. Gradually, he comes to realize that Michiko should not be obliged to look after him for the rest of his life, so he arranges a marriage for her.

films.title: News from Home
films.summary: Impersonal and beautiful images of Akerman's life in New York are combined with letters from her loving but manipulative mother, read by Akerman herself.

films.title: Silent Night, Deadly Night 5: The Toy Maker
films.summary: A toy maker's creations display some very human -- and deadly -- tendencies.

films.title: Ganja & Hess
films.summary: After being stabbed with an ancient, germ-infested knife, a doctor finds himself with an insatiable desire for blood.

films.title: Closure
films.summary: After his teenage son goes missing, Daniel scours the depths of the Vistula River, torn between the dread of a fatal leap and the hope that his son may still be alive.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">CLOSURE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">MICHAŁ MARCZAK // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Queen at Sea
films.summary: As advanced dementia erodes an older woman's ability to communicate her inner life, her husband and daughter struggle to act in her best interests, navigating love and the fragile boundaries between care, protection and autonomy.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">QUEEN AT SEA</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">LANCE HAMMER // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: I Play Rocky
films.summary: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">I PLAY ROCKY</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">PETER FARRELLY // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Unzipped
films.summary: Isaac Mizrahi, one of the most successful designers in high fashion, plans his fall 1994 collection.

films.title: Once Upon a Time... in Hollywood
films.summary: Los Angeles, 1969. TV star Rick Dalton, a struggling actor specializing in westerns, and stuntman Cliff Booth, his best friend, try to survive in a constantly changing movie industry. Dalton is the neighbor of the young and promising actress and model Sharon Tate, who has just married the prestigious Polish director Roman Polanski…

films.title: Blade Runner
films.summary: In the smog-choked dystopian Los Angeles of 2019, blade runner Rick Deckard is called out of retirement to terminate a quartet of replicants who have escaped to Earth seeking their creator for a way to extend their short life spans.

films.title: Rosemary's Baby
films.summary: A young couple, Rosemary and Guy, moves into an infamous New York apartment building, known by frightening legends and mysterious events, with the purpose of starting a family.

films.title: Suspiria
films.summary: An American newcomer to a prestigious German ballet academy comes to realize that the school is a front for something sinister amid a series of grisly murders.
